entries.back_en: Do you know why they call him 'two-eyes'? It's very common for the more experienced Reynis to lose an eye. That lot is very dangerous, but this is a Reynis who rose up through the ranks with both eyes intact, meaning he's practically a king in a world of the blind!
entries.note: Omite 'Hey, friend'; 'one-eyed world' virou 'mundo de cegos' (mudança sutil da imagem).
